arxiv-1912-02743.title: Toward Filament Segmentation Using Deep Neural Networks
arxiv-1912-02743.creator: Azim Ahmadzadeh 1 , Sushant S. Mahajan 2 , Dustin J. Kempton 1 , Rafal A. Angryk 1 and Shihao Ji 1
arxiv-1912-02743.description: Abstract We use a well-known deep neural network framework, called Mask R-CNN, for identification of solar filaments in full-disk H- α \alpha images from Big Bear Solar Observatory (BBSO). The image data, collected from BBSO’s archive, are integrated with the spatiotemporal metadata of filaments retrieved from the Heliophysics Events Knowledgebase (HEK) system.

arxiv-2109-03554.title: Evolving Decomposed Plasticity Rules for Information-Bottlenecked Meta-Learning
arxiv-2109-03554.creator: Fan Wang wang.fan@baidu.com, Hao Tian tianhao@baidu.com, Haoyi Xiong xionghaoyi@baidu.com, Hua Wu wu_hua@baidu.com, Jie Fu fujie@baai.ac.cn, Yang Cao forrest@ustc.edu.cn, Yu Kang kangduyu@ustc.edu.cn, Haifeng Wang wanghaifeng@baidu.com
arxiv-2109-03554.description: Abstract Artificial neural networks (ANNs) are typically confined to accomplishing pre-defined tasks by learning a set of static parameters. In contrast, biological neural networks (BNNs) can adapt to various new tasks by continually updating the neural connections based on the inputs, which is aligned with the paradigm of learning effective learning rules in addition to static parameters, e.g. , meta-learning.

arxiv-2202-01295.description: Abstract . A conjecture by Campana and Peternell says that if a positive multiple of K X K_{X} is linearly equivalent to an effective divisor D D plus a pseudo-effective divisor, then the Kodaira dimension of X X should be at least as big as the Iitaka dimension of D D .

arxiv-2202-08902.creator: Alex Bespalov, David J. Silvester
arxiv-2202-08902.description: Abstract . A multilevel adaptive refinement strategy for solving linear elliptic partial differential equations with random data is recalled in this work. The strategy extends the a posteriori error estimation framework introduced by Guignard & Nobile in 2018 ( SIAM J. Numer. Anal. , 56 , 3121–3143) to cover problems with a nonaffine parametric coefficient dependence.

arxiv-2505-08111.title: Sleep Position Classification using Transfer Learning for Bed-based Pressure Sensors
arxiv-2505-08111.creator: Olivier Papillon, Rafik Goubran, Life Fellow IEEE, James Green, Senior Member IEEE, Julien Larivière-Chartier, Caitlin Higginson, Frank Knoefel, MD, Rébecca Robillard
arxiv-2505-08111.description: Abstract Bed-based pressure-sensitive mats (PSMs) offer a non-intrusive way of monitoring patients during sleep. Sleep positions can affect sleep quality and the prevalence of sleep disorders, such as apnea.

pmc-12973141.title: Longitudinal plasma interleukin‐6 and post‐stroke cognitive outcomes: The Stroke‐IMPaCT study
pmc-12973141.creator: Natasha S. Carmichael, Harry R. Deijnen, Siew Yan Wong, Thomas O. Williams, Evangelos Kontopantelis, Luke Cowie, Eileen Jones, Lauren Drag, Marion S. Buckwalter, John R. Grainger, Stuart M. Allan, Craig J. Smith
pmc-12973141.description: INTRODUCTIONInflammatory factors, particularly interleukin (IL)‐6, are implicated in post‐stroke cognitive decline, yet the association with longitudinal changes in these markers remains unclear.METHODSPlasma IL‐6 and other inflammatory markers were measured within 96 hours of ischemic stroke, and at 6–9 and 18–21 months, alongside cognitive assessment. Associations between inflammatory factors and cognition were examined using adjusted regression models.

uslaw-usc-t49-s80102.title: 49 U.S.C. § 80102 — Application
uslaw-usc-t49-s80102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s80102.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Chapter 801 (Bills Of Lading). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. This chapter applies to a bill of lading when the bill is issued by a common carrier for the transportation of goods— (1) between a place in the District of Columbia and another place in the District of Columbia; (2) between a place in a territory.
